summary: Proposes improvements to unicast Reverse Path Forwarding for detecting and reducing source address spoofing. It explains why strict, loose, and the existing feasible-path uRPF still have shortcomings and describes an enhanced approach. It relates to RFC 3704 and BCP 38.

eli5.summary: Spoofers write fake return addresses. Routers can check whether a letter could really have come from where it claims, and this does that more carefully.
